outlook.statement: Company is gradually rebuilding momentum after a difficult phase marked by financial constraints, economic pressures, liquidity challenges, and the impact of the pandemic. Earned net profit of Rs. 210 lakh in quarter ended 30th September 2026 and is hopeful for better performance in future.

India rice market size estimated at USD 49.32 billion in 2026, growing to USD 62.09 billion by 2031 at 4.72% CAGR. Removal of September 2024 ban on non-basmati white rice exports has increased export opportunities.

Packaged food market valued at USD 6.34 trillion in 2025, estimated to grow from USD 6.61 trillion in 2026 to USD 8.15 trillion by 2031 at 4.28% CAGR. Growth driven by urbanization, rising disposable income, demand for convenient nutrient-dense products, ethnic/global flavors, and health-focused products.

Company aims to make Kohinoor Foods Ltd. a leading name in global food business, bring authentic Indian flavours worldwide, develop products, enhance operational efficiency, and execute strategies for sustainable growth.

Focused on business recovery and sustainable growth through initiatives: identifying investors for fund infusion, expanding global presence, expanding product portfolio, expanding customer base, leveraging market expertise, improving operational efficiencies, launching food products on domestic e-commerce platforms.
Company is taking further steps to improve the earning position and is optimistic of earning good profits in coming years.
During the quarter ended 30th September 2026, the Company has earned a Net Profit of Rs. 210 Lakh and is hopeful for better performance in its future.

The management believes the company can continue as a going concern based on the sanction of revised/revival of one time settlement by the lenders, which has been fully paid, and interest shown by prospective investors.

The management of the Company believes that it can continue as a going concern, based on the sanction of revised / revival of one time settlement by the lenders, which has been fully paid by the company and the interest shown by Prospective Investors in the Company.
The company is planning to operate the rice manufacturing unit (on lease basis) from Kandla Gujarat to sustain its rice business.

Actual results may differ from those expressed in the statement. Important factors that could influence the Company's operations include global and domestic demand and supply conditions affecting selling prices of finished goods, input availability and prices, changes in Government Regulations, Tax laws.
The company expects to notch up good numbers in the next financial year through some exciting product launches and expanding & streamlining the distribution network.

Steps are continuously being taken to promote the branded sales in overseas market. The company is exciting product launches and expanding & streamlining the distribution network in domestic as well as in International Market.
Due to liquidity problem and banking restrictions, the exports were badly affected, during the year. However, the Company has strong Global Network and expect the exports to revive soon.
The company continues to be going concern based on the sanction of revised / revival of One Time Settlement by lead Bank, which has been fully paid by the company.
